title: Recurring Dreams Outside of Mall World
content: Does anyone else have recurring dreams in places that aren’t necessarily malls? As an example, for several years I had dreams where I was in different homes that I recognized from my childhood. In my dreams, though, there were hidden rooms throughout the house, but you couldn’t always get to those rooms. There was always a vague sense of dread, too. Sometimes these turn into nightmares. Maybe by dreaming about familiar locations it helps our subconscious process whatever is going on in our lives?
